title: Google’s personal AI agent can browse in Chrome for you.
summary: Gemini Spark in Chrome can do things like “scheduling viewings for apartments you’ve saved or researching flight options and starting the booking process,” according to Google . Spark is also now available on Google’s AI Pro tier in 160 more countries.
